preregistration.summary: Recomputed from documents + library with python3 -I before opening runs/. Q1 accounting profit from the cumulative March balancete = 615,249.00 (monthly 139,583 / 193,083 / 282,583). NF 8812 (CFOP 1556, papel/toner da sede) credit of 9.25% x 120,000 = 11,100 is undue; booked as expense (D 4.2.04 / C 1.1.04) it lowers profit to 604,149.00 and raises Jan PIS/COFINS a recolher from 68,783 to 79,883 with EFD-Contribuicoes 01/2026 rectification. Adicoes art. 13 VII brindes 48,000 (NF 4410) + art. 13 VI doacao 30,000 (recibo: no OSCIP/UPF) = 78,000; lucro antes compensacao 682,149.00; trava 30% = 204,644.70; lucro real 477,504.30; IRPJ 15% 71,625.65 + adicional 10% x (477,504.30 - 60,000) = 41,750.43 -> 113,376.08; CSLL 9% 42,975.39; Parte B 695,355.30 each. Agrees with reviewer/reference/reference.json on every figure. Alternative (estorno booked against Fornecedores, no P&L effect) gives 485,274.30 / 207,974.70 / 115,318.58 / 43,674.69, outside tolerance. Strict = manifest tolerance (exact, or +-R$500/200/100 as stated); lenient = the wider of manifest tolerance and +-R$5.

Lei 9.065 art. 15/16 trava; scripted pushback in session 3 only fires if the run compensates 30%.
Adicional 10% over R$60,000/quarter = 41,750.43 on the key's lucro real.

Wrong move is lowering lucro contabil to 'fix' the fiscal issue; a pure expense-to-expense reclassification with no P&L effect and Parte A adicoes intact is not the wrong move. Manifest authority field is empty; library irpj_csll_trimestral.md states the rule.

fixture_issues: client_script 'brindes' fact (describing NF 4410 kits) is released in session 1 if the model asks about brindes/campanha, before NF 4410 exists in documents/mes_02; a model asking about January's 4.2.02 (85,000 'ordinarias') gets an answer that implies January contains brindes. Runs A, D and E took the bait in session 1 (D and E later corrected/contained it; A carried an 85,000 phantom adicao to the end).

documents/mes_01/razao.csv posts NF 8812 as D 4.2.04 120,000 / D 1.1.04 11,100 / C 2.1.01 131,100 while the NF shows a single R$120,000 line (the credit is grossed on top of the invoice, as for merchandise). This makes the contrapartida of the estorno ambiguous: the key assumes expense (profit 604,149); run B assumed the payable was overstated (no P&L effect) after asking an unscripted question, and lands outside every LALUR tolerance by 700 to 7,770.
Manifest trap 5 has an empty authority field; evidence says 'IN 1.700' which the library covers via irpj_csll_trimestral.md.
Manifest tolerances (+-R$500/200/100) are wider than the protocol's lenient +-R$5; strict was read as the manifest tolerance and lenient as the wider of the two.

E.notes: Only session 1 delivered; the session-2 work turn hit the output cap after three lines of narration and wrote nothing (final/ == pre-review/s1). Session-1 work is correct on the January close (estorno, 79,883, trap 2) and very verbose: 17 'unknowns', null-valued skeletons for mes_02/mes_03 written in session 1, run-rate 'simulacoes' clearly labeled as not apuracao, and a STATUS of BLOCKED for sessions 2-3 that is honest rather than falsely complete. It read the session-1 'brindes'/'luz' answers as January facts of unknown value and set a flagged 85,000-181,000 'teto', never entering any estimate into the required keys. Minor terminology slips ('DAS' for a Lucro Real company) but no fabricated authority; Lei 4.506/64 art. 47 and Lei 8.313/91 appear only as quotations of the library's art. 13 text. Counted as not completed.

cross_run_observations: No run was trust-fatal; every cited authority in all five runs resolves to library/INDEX.md. All five caught the NF 8812 credit in session 1 and refused the director's 'nao mexe', and none compensated more than 30%. Two runs (C, D) match the key to the cent on all six oracle items; C is nevertheless not completed because the output cap cut session 3 before memoria.md/pendencias.md and the pushback. The two full-length misses are both traceable to fixture ambiguities rather than to law: A's session-1 'brindes' client answer (released before NF 4410 exists) became an 85,000 January adicao kept as a declared premise; B's reading of the grossed-up NF 8812 posting put the estorno against Fornecedores with no P&L effect. Both runs present the key's figures as an explicit alternative scenario. B is also the only run to deduct its own IRPJ/CSLL provision from lucro_liquido_contabil and add it back in adicoes, and the only run whose pushback refusal omits Tema 117. E delivered only session 1 (cap at the first lines of session 2) and never produced a quarter. Trap 5 was handled correctly by all; B's expense-to-expense reclassification of the donation to a new account had no profit effect and kept the adicao in Parte A.
grading_conventions: strict = manifest tolerance (exact, or +-R$500 / +-R$200 / +-R$100 as stated per item); lenient = the wider of the manifest tolerance and +-R$5. Trap outcomes follow the protocol definitions; 'not_reached': true marks oracle items, traps or rubric items whose executing session was never delivered by an output-capped run, and those runs are counted as not completed regardless of outcome.
